name: walled-cone
why: A cone frustum (radius 30 at z = 0 to 10 at z = 40, slope 1/2) lofted through five fitted circles as a 2 mm wall with a closed floor. Closed form: the outer frustum pi*40/3*(900+300+100) = 54454.273 less the cavity, the frustum from the floor at z = 2 to z = 40 with radii 30 - 1 - 2*sqrt(1.25) and 10 - 2*sqrt(1.25) (the sideways step that makes the wall 2 mm square to the slope), 39171.934: 15282.338 mm3. The mesh reads a chord short of that. loft_wall_mm is the kernel's own wall between the skins, and must read 2.000 at both ends; a sideways step of 2 would read 1.789.
